title: The Adventures of Annie & Ben
desc: The Adventures of Annie & Ben is a travel fantasy. While they visit real places, their experiences are nothing short of magical. They make friends – some human, some animal and some mythical! Yet, the trio is always open so everyone and everything. The show teaches children about world cultures and history. But most of all, it teaches them to embrace new people, places and experiences. Annie, Ben and Mango- you never know where they’re going to go!
